title: The Dosa Corner - Golden Crisp & Spice
concept: A high-sensory visual journey that opens with an explosive sizzle on a hot iron tawa, follows a glowing steam ribbon through crispy dosa varieties and fresh chutneys, and concludes with an irresistible value offer.
visual_world: A warm, glowing street-bento aesthetic featuring dark teal backdrop walls (#0F2C2E), rich turmeric yellow highlights (#F2A922), spicy chili accents (#E74C3C), and glowing golden steam vector curves.
hero_motif: The iconic, ultra-crispy golden conical paper-roast dosa.
through_line: A glowing turmeric-gold vector steam ribbon that spirals up from the hot tawa and weaves through every scene, connecting dishes, text callouts, and the final feast.

design_system.illustration_style: Vibrant layered vector illustration with subtle warm gradients, tactile spice splashes, and clean geometric lighting highlights.
design_system.motion_style: Sizzling, fluid, and appetisingly snappy motion with smooth spring eases.
design_system.persistent_ui: Top-left pill badge displaying 'The Dosa Corner' logo icon in turmeric gold, with a thin amber progress bar along the bottom edge.

voice.name: Gacrux
voice.persona: Warm, enthusiastic, and friendly Indian storyteller voice with a conversational rhythm.

scenes.narration: Listen to that sizzle... that is the sound of pure, golden crunch.

on_screen_text.headline: Hear That Golden Sizzle?
on_screen_text.support: Fresh off the blazing cast-iron tawa

scenes.visual_brief: Macro top-down view of a dark cast-iron tawa. Smooth white batter swirls outward in a fast vector spiral while droplets of golden ghee pop with energetic spark graphics and steam curves surge upward.
A dull gray cardboard takeout container appears on screen but is instantly sliced diagonally by the glowing turmeric steam ribbon, dissolving the drab box into vibrant amber sparks.
scenes.carry_over: The glowing turmeric steam ribbon sweeps across from Scene 1, slicing through the frame.

scenes.narration: Welcome to The Dosa Corner, where every crepe is spun fresh and laced with pure ghee.
scenes.visual_brief: Hero visual of a towering, golden conical paper-roast dosa rising smoothly off the tawa. Micro-droplets of glistening ghee shine on its crisp lattice texture against a warm glowing backdrop.
scenes.carry_over: The steam ribbon wraps around the base of the rising cone paper-roast dosa.

scenes.narration: From ultra-thin paper roasts to spiced potato masala and fiery ghee podi specials.
scenes.visual_brief: A dynamic 3-card carousel featuring three house specials: classic paper roast cone, folded spiced potato masala dosa, and a brilliant red podi-dusted dosa with melting butter.
scenes.carry_over: The golden cone dosa morphs into the center card, anchored by the steam ribbon weaving through the three dosa variants.

scenes.narration: Dipped into three handcrafted chutneys and piping hot sambar.

on_screen_text.headline: 3 Fresh Chutneys + Hot Sambar
on_screen_text.support: Coconut, spicy tomato, and mint dips

scenes.visual_brief: Top-down geometric layout featuring three colorful ceramic chutney pots—creamy white coconut, vibrant orange tomato-onion, mint green—encircling a steaming bowl of aromatic sambar with mustard seed garnish.
scenes.carry_over: The steam ribbon loops down from the dosa tray to swirl around the central sambar bowl and three chutney pots.

scenes.narration: Crafted from fresh-ground batter daily—combos start at just ninety-nine rupees!
scenes.visual_brief: A bold, sunburst value badge pops into the frame showing '₹99 Special'. Stylized vector rice grains and urad dal float gently in an orbital motion around the offer stamp.
scenes.carry_over: The steam ribbon loops into a circular badge holding the price tag while batter ingredients float around it.

scenes.narration: Visit The Dosa Corner today, or order online at dosacorner.com!
scenes.visual_brief: Grand final platter on a vibrant green banana leaf displaying the golden cone dosa, all three chutneys, hot sambar, and a 'Combos from ₹99' sticker. Bold brand logo and clear web address frame the bottom.
scenes.carry_over: The steam ribbon lands onto the final banana leaf feast, returning full circle to the cast-iron tawa icon in the top corner.
